title: Field group `visibleWhen`: a predicate that faults renders the whole section (fail-OPEN) on the form and the detail page, while the spec declares this slot fail-CLOSED
body:
Filing gate: ① — violation of a declared contract (the spec's published describe text for this slot), reproduced through the console.

Path: records-forms.field-group-visible-when
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24572 · records-forms.field-group-visible-when · negative[2]
Checklist priority: P1 (the item's negative[2] instructs that this drift be captured and filed; the clause's own FAIL shape — blank form / crash — did not occur)
type: Bug — the renderer's behaviour contradicts the declared direction of the slot
Reader who acts: the objectui dev seat that takes this card from triage (renderer half: plugin-form field-group section gating and record:details group resolution). If the maintainer rules the declared direction itself should change instead, the edit is a spec describe change in objectstack — this card records the drift either way.
Dup check (open + closed): objectui search "field group visibleWhen faulting predicate shows section safe default true fail-closed" → 2 hits, both closed and not this defect: #11630 (group predicate did not gate the detail page — fixed), #4051 (fail-open SILENTLY — now loud, the diagnostic below proves it). objectstack search "visibleWhen field group fail-open fail-closed faulting predicate safe default" → 9 hits, none on this slot's render direction; nearest: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17778 (ADR-0137 ruling for the field-rule triad: fail-open at render), objectstack-ai/objectstack#22402 / objectstack-ai/objectstack#22157 (select-option server gate), objectstack-ai/objectstack#19727, objectstack-ai/objectstack#6716.

reach: on a stock showcase boot, an object whose field group carries `visibleWhen: "record.kind =="` (or `"record.no_such_field == 'x'"`) saves 200 and its edit form and detail page render the group's section (measured at objectui 4016370af3c9, framework 5b14b7f3).

## The declared contract

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` describe: "Section visibility predicate (CEL) — the whole group (header included) is shown only when TRUE, else hidden (fail-closed)."; the docblock above it: "a faulting predicate — fail-closed) hides the WHOLE group, header …".
- ADR-0137 (predicate fault semantics are contract) keeps the field-rule triad fail-open at render (D3), and its scope note names `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` as carrying its OWN declared fail-closed direction that the triad ruling does not convert.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the showcase; as admin create a writable package (`POST /api/v1/packages` with a manifest).
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_group_gate?package=PKG` with fields `name`, `kind` (select basic/pro), `pro_seats`, `pro_notes`, and one field group `pro_details` (members `pro_seats`, `pro_notes`) whose `visibleWhen` is `"record.kind =="` → **200**. Repeat with `"record.no_such_field == 'x'"` → **200**.
3. Publish, create a record, open `/record/ID/edit` and the record detail page.
4. Actual: the "Pro details" section (header and members) is SHOWN on both surfaces; the browser console logs `[object-ui] A conditional predicate failed to evaluate (visibleWhen of group 'pro_details' of record:details …) and was treated as its safe default (true) … [parse] Unexpected token: EOF`.
5. Expected per the declared contract: the section is hidden (fail-closed).

A well-formed predicate gates correctly on both surfaces (`record.kind == 'pro'`), so this is the fault direction only.

## Related observation (same run, not this card's subject)

Authoring accepts the syntactically broken `"record.kind =="` with 200 — no parse-time check on this slot.

Full evidence: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24572.
